frontEvidence.note: Five registered audit frontend paths do not yet exist; no existing implemented interface was overwritten.

body.objectId: UUID|null; mandatory; nonnull requires a specific module
body.dateFrom: YYYY-MM-DD|null, inclusive Asia/Shanghai local day start
body.dateTo: YYYY-MM-DD|null, inclusive Asia/Shanghai day through next local midnight exclusive
body.page: positive safe integer with safe offset

item.occurredAt: actual UTC timestamp preserving up to6 fractional digits|null; never fill from receipt/import/current time

object.name: current safe native name/loginName|null
object.code: current native code if actual applicable|null

item.credentialActions: [] or actual closed CREATE/RESET_PASSWORD actions from safe account_credentials metadata; no password/hash/tag

auditValue.ABSENT: {state:'ABSENT'}: sparse original evidence does not contain this field; not zero/null/unchanged
auditValue.ROW_COUNT: {state:'ROW_COUNT',value:nonnegativeInteger}: changed child rows recorded in original sparse audit; not total currently linked rows

projection.root: Closed per-module allowlist of actual safe root fields, incl nine product prices as exact strings, IDs/state/version. Only keys actually present before/after appear.
projection.children: skus/barcodes/images/accounts/payment_halls projected as counts only, with label explicitly stating changed rows. No arbitrary nested JSON, file_ref, session, token, credential/hash/password/salt/HMAC/request hash/key or result_data returned.
projection.credentialMetadata: Only the two closed action names; no credential content or raw audit object. Unknown/malformed permitted-field values reject read as integrity failure, not silently replace with blank.
projection.labels: object/actor labels are current native reference labels, not invented historical snapshots; raw stored before/after remain original.

authorization.roles: Current ADMIN all12 modules; current WAREHOUSE ordinary modules excluding STAFF/ACCOUNT; SALESPERSON denied. ALL removes unauthorized families before count/page; explicit forbidden family gives403 before object lookup.
authorization.driver: Reuse D1 actual current-identity/hall/role checks in original MaintenancePgUnitOfWork read callback. STAFF/ACCOUNT or ADMIN ALL validates ACCOUNT LIST first; ordinary families validate own LIST; CUSTOMER/SUPPLIER reuse same ADMIN/WAREHOUSE current-identity gate through PRODUCT LIST plus exact leaf query scope, no new shared kind/write authority.
authorization.objects: Query joins only retained native objects in authorized module scope. Exact objectId is parameterized; nonexistent/unavailable target yields legitimate zero result, never discloses whether forbidden object exists. Logical-deleted retained objects remain available to authorized maintenance audit history.
authorization.historicalCustomer: Optional existing HistoricalCustomerExclusionCapability bound to actual D1 driver selects same exact26 exclusion in CUSTOMER object scope; absent capability never calls new routine. Host cannot publish exact2 into legacy current profile.
authorization.source: audit_change joined to COMMITTED operation_receipt by operationId,actor,targetKind,targetId,action and receipt result version; no raw journal or unauthenticated actor inference

pagination.query: One statement computes exact total and bounded page after permissions and all filters in the same database snapshot; date filters use Asia/Shanghai; literal strpos search, not LIKE expansion.
pagination.order: occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST, audit id DESC; ties deterministic. Concurrent new operations can affect later offset-page requests; refresh explicitly, no frozen multi-request snapshot claim.
pagination.bounds: Bounded100-row response; only SQL safe projection, no full raw16MiB audit fetch. Overflow/unknown typed content fails, never truncates.

500: INTERNAL_ERROR sanitized; retain last successful frontend page with clear error, do not fabricate empty records

host: C/D1 owns mounting/authentication/actual driver and exact26 verified capability; D2 supplies createSettingsAuditHttpPlugin and PostgresSettingsAuditUnitOfWork. No DB columns/tables/migrations/indices or shared host changes requested.
tests: Only new contract/permission/projection/filter/SQL/sanitizedHTTP and affected integration. No previous maintenance or media retest.
